definitions.gloss: here and there; scattered; dotted about
definitions.explanation: Describes things distributed sparsely and irregularly across a surface or area, like dots on a canvas.

examples.japanese: ⟦{島|しま}→島：00885_shima⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{点々|てんてん}と⟦{浮|う}かんでいる→浮かぶ：03916_ukabu⟧。
examples.english: Islands are scattered across the water.

examples.japanese: ⟦{野原|のはら}→野原：14417_nohara⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{花|はな}→花：00523_hana⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{点々|てんてん}と⟦{咲|さ}いている→咲く：08150_saku⟧。
examples.english: Flowers are blooming here and there in the field.

examples.japanese: ⟦{雪|ゆき}→雪：00584_yuki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{上|うえ}→上：00682_ue⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{動物|どうぶつ}→動物：01480_doubutsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{足跡|あしあと}→足跡：04095_ashiato⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{点々|てんてん}と⟦{続|つづ}いていた→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧。
examples.english: Animal footprints dotted the snow, trailing off into the distance.

notes:
USAGE:
{点々|てんてん}と is an adverb describing things distributed sparsely like dots. It conveys a visual image of items spread out with space between them.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {点々|てんてん}と⟦{散|ち}らばる→散らばる：12713_chirabaru⟧ (to be scattered about)
- {点々|てんてん}と⟦{続|つづ}く→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧ (to continue in a dotted line)
- {点々|てんてん}と⟦{浮|う}かぶ→浮かぶ：03916_ukabu⟧ (to float here and there)

COMMON PATTERNS:
⟦{点々|てんてん}→点々：03974_tenten⟧ can also be used as a noun meaning "dots" or "dotted marks." When used with ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧, it functions as an adverb.
